findings.description: The code uses `cin >> filename` to read the filename, which can lead to buffer overflow if the user inputs a very long filename.
The code directly uses the user-provided filename to open a file, which can lead to file path traversal attacks.
The variables `cases`, `partyAmount`, and `voteAmount` are read from the file without checking if the file is successfully opened.
The code lacks proper error handling for file operations and input parsing.
